description: Tick your stack (Node, Python, Java…) and get a combined, ready-to-commit .gitignore file.

faqs.a: Node, Python, Java, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, .NET, macOS, Windows, Linux, VS Code, and IntelliJ — mix and match.
Yes — templates are merged with a section header per stack and duplicates removed.
The templates follow widely used community conventions for each ecosystem.
Click Download .gitignore and place the file at your repository root.
faqs.q: How do I use the file?

howto: Tick the stacks and tools your project uses.
Click Generate — the merged .gitignore appears below.
title: .gitignore Generator
